output.summary_en: A forwarded message in Indonesian claims that COVID-19 vaccines contain microchips designed to track individuals who receive them. The message urges recipients to share the warning across all groups before it gets deleted.

claims.claim_original: Vaksin COVID-19 mengandung microchip untuk melacak setiap orang yang sudah divaksin.
claims.claim_en: COVID-19 vaccines contain microchips to track individuals who receive them.
